note: Pizzica from Salento, tammurriata from around Naples and tarantellas from Calabria and the Avellino hills, from 1950s field recordings to today's revival bands. Many titles are in local dialect and are spelled as the releases print them.

size.basis: Archive side: Lomax and Carpitella's 1954-55 field tapes (Rounder Italian Treasury: Salento, Calabria, Naples/Campania volumes; Folkways FE 4265 holds five tarantella items of 20 tracks), Folkways' Italian-American volumes (Calabria Bella 1979, Festa Italiana) and 78s by Italian-American dance orchestras. Revival side: Canzoniere Grecanico Salentino alone has about 18 albums since 1975, plus Officina Zoè, NCCP, Eugenio Bennato/Taranta Power, Alla Bua, Uccio Aloisi, Tammurriata di Scafati and the yearly Notte della Taranta concerts since 1998, each album carrying several pizziche or tarantellas. Range is a reasoned guess, not a catalogue count; core is what a Salento or Campania player would call essential across the regional forms.
